examples.question: What company is Alex Hormozi the founder of, and what does it generate in revenue?
examples.reference_answer: Alex Hormozi is the founder of acquisition.com (referred to as acquisitions.com), a portfolio of companies generating hundreds of millions of dollars in aggregate revenue per year.

evidence.quote:
I'm
Alex Hormozi and the founder of
acquisitions.com. It's a portfolio of
companies that generate hundreds of
millions of dollars in revenue per year
in aggregate.

examples.question: How does Alex Hormozi define commitment?
examples.reference_answer: Hormozi defines commitment as the elimination of alternatives.

evidence.quote:
I see commitment as the elimination of
alternatives. So, if I get married, then
I eliminate all alternatives to the
person that I'm married to. Right? That
is commitment, right?

examples.question: According to Alex Hormozi, how can you measure how powerful an individual is?
examples.reference_answer: A person's power can be measured by the distance between when they make a decision and when that decision actually happens in reality.

evidence.quote:
By the
way, you can measure how powerful
someone is by the distance between when
they make a decision and when it happens
in reality.

examples.question: What quote from Paul Graham regarding wealth and pain is cited?
examples.reference_answer: Paul Graham stated that to make a million dollars, a person must endure a million dollars worth of pain.

evidence.quote:
And so, I love
this quote from Paul Graham. He said,
"If you want to make a million dollars,
you have to endure a million dollars
worth of pain."

examples.question: Why does Alex Hormozi state that consistent champions feel relieved rather than excited when they win?
examples.reference_answer: They feel relief because they hate losing more than they love winning, and their level of preparation leads them to expect the win.

evidence.quote:
The people who always and very
consistently hit first place and win the
championships are relieved because they
tend to hate losing more than they love
winning. and they expected to win
because of the level of preparation they
had compared to everyone
else.

examples.question: How long does Alex Hormozi claim it takes to become competent at nearly any skill?
examples.reference_answer: He states that a person can become competent at almost any skill in about 20 hours.

evidence.quote:
You can beat most people
at anything if you just stick with it
for a year. You can become competent at
just about any skill in 20 hours.

examples.question: What method does Alex Hormozi recommend to overcome fear and self-doubt instead of using affirmations?
examples.reference_answer: He recommends outworking self-doubt through repetition and stimuli habituation—exposing oneself to the uncomfortable or bad situation repeatedly until it becomes normal.

evidence.quote:
Outwork your
self-doubt through repetition, not
affirmations. You don't do it through
belief. You do it through stimuli
habituation, which is just fancy words
for saying you expose yourself to the
bad things so many times they get used
to and it's no longer a bad thing
anymore.

examples.question: According to the speaker, what is the distinction between guilt and shame?
examples.reference_answer: Guilt occurs when you break your own internal rules, whereas shame occurs when you break the rules set by other people.

evidence.quote:
difference between shame and
guilt? Guilt is when you break your own
rules. Shame is when you break other
people's rules.
